global_rules: Preserve every null, adverse, retracted, protocol-invalid and CANNOT_CHECK result that constrains a headline claim.
Do not promote open-pull-request analyses until merged, independently checked, rebound and rendered.
Do not treat signatures, replay, provenance, model diversity or same-programme agreement as external scientific authority.
Do not replace a failed frozen gate with a favorable secondary metric or a same-identity rescue study.
Charge matched information, action support, evaluator access, compute, memory, preprocessing and external services.
Represent declined analyses as named values such as NOT_COMPUTED_BY_PROTOCOL rather than absent fields.
Separate proof validity, statement adequacy, empirical transfer, production transfer and journal authority.
No protected Task-3 implementation file may be modified by this package.
